key_terms.فَسَوْفَ: Then they will / So they shall

ai.seo_question: What will the disbelievers do on the Day of Judgment when they see the consequences of their actions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological torment of the disbelievers who, upon witnessing the reality of divine justice, desire the release of death but find it delayed as a form of prolonged punishment. This reflects the concept of 'Bala' (trial) turning into 'Adhab' (punishment), where the very thing they sought becomes inaccessible, emphasizing the finality of their spiritual state.
